notes.title: Romance, Fun, and Mystery - Play the Demo Today!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/dfe3581f389d20e51f305fe30eddaa64a3ffc79b.jpg

The wait is over! With just a few clicks, you can be among the first to meet the newest ladies. Dive in and explore now!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/662a2e7d9e2aca57044661a1c7c8e93ab2befa7b.png

Item Management System

 Item Placement: This is the core mechanic of Combat. You need to place items into designated slots to prepare for Socializing.
 Star-Link System: Some special items have gray stars around them. When you place items of the same type next to each other, you activate the star’s buff, boosting the item’s power and stats.
 Item Merge: This feature allows you to combine two items into a brand-new, higher-rarity item with superior stats.
 Item Upgrade: This feature lets you enhance an item while keeping its original form and stats. With each level-up, the item's attributes increase accordingly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/2fd85497bc880cebd256bcdca2fccc342520c152.png


Build Your Playstyle with 4 Unique Traits and dominate your journey!

 Charm: High Impact power and increased critical hit chance. Strike hard, strike fast.
 Knowledge: Specializes in debuffs and psychological effects, causing damage over time. Balanced Impact power with high stamina.
 Confidence: Built for defense, strong Steadfastness and high Confidence make you an unshakable force.
 Kindness: Exceptional healing abilities with solid Confidence Points and high stamina to keep you going.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/5905782ea4b3f369508afd638a9bb2c8115d0ebe.png


Master the Meta & Build Your Ultimate Strategy

 Impact Build: Strike hard. This build maximizes Impact power, letting you overwhelm opponents before they react.
 Confidence Build: Focus on defense with high Steadfastness and Confidence, making you a fortress.
 Steadfast (Defense): Specializes in barrier-based defense, using items with high protection stats and buffs to absorb Impact before they even touch your Confidence.
 Debuff Build: Play the long game and apply psychological effects and negative debuffs to drain your opponent’s Confidence over time, lasting throughout social encounters.
 Recovery Build: Stay in the conversation with high-confidence recovery. Use items that restore Confidence and Stamina continuously to outlast your opponents.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/354808e28a5b1175d0ca228959c1d34e87f99dac.png


That’s not all! You can also build your character with sets that match your personality:

Anime Set: No explanation needed. You’re a true fan of those big, bad, beautiful eyes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/dd4a3da2504332cc2436d43a0c273d684c6cd217.png

Intellectual Set: Some may have greater wealth, but few can rival the depth of your intellect.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/1cfc1051a99f6efaf6a9a4f2e1e3d2cf98bf580c.png

Bad Boy Set: You fear nothing. Nothing stands in your way to glory.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/15ee737f8a96f5667b0b46292163c1d63445bcc1.png

Wanderer Set: A free spirit, always on the move, chasing new adventures and fresh horizons.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/68d75662ca23cee6823475e2cc5bd7adc4d6f8d4.png


Whatever your age is, youthful and charming college girls… wait, no, what we meant to say is that education is incredibly important! That’s why enrolling and expanding your academic career should be your top priority. After all, you’re here for the valuable knowledge, right? Right?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f1a893f45f6570c82acd600ecd77d1d882b2298a.jpg


But let’s be real, school life isn’t just about textbooks or lectures from that beautiful professor… Whoops, got sidetracked again. School life is also about those carefree moments, the fun, the lack of stress (well, not too much stress). And that’s exactly why every student’s dorm room needs a gaming PC, for those times when skipping homework just makes sense.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/44317cd549e8e3259e06cad453f9c1fef36e2ad7.jpg


Of course, don’t forget to hit the gym! Staying in shape will make the college girls and the sexy professor… ahem, we mean, it’ll keep you healthy, focused, and ready to absorb all that valuable knowledge 😏 And that’s just the beginning. There are plenty more life-sim activities waiting for you! Every activity boosts your traits, which, in turn, levels up your core stats, making you stronger in the art of socializing.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/2235ca8f2791bc466490bdaf95cf8b66c93ac4f1.png


From starting alone to connecting hearts. The choices you make today will shape your future. This isn’t just a journey of knowledge. It’s a second home where unforgettable romances unfold.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/637b2bf1db9720ad7150b04b544cbdb7671f051d.png


Pick a name and choose a trait that defines you. Win the hearts of your dream girls. Download the demo now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166720/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student_Demo/
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/231de74ef8747d7bf79ee2f65b8668c2c26104fb.gif


And remember. Your Wishlist count lets the girls know just how many unforgettable, heartwarming moments they’ll get to share with you. 💖 Support Love n Life: Happy Student now! 💖
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149980/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student/

Our development team will continue to update and refine the demo in the coming days. You can expect to see improvements based on both our efforts and your valuable feedback. And don't forget, exciting romantic content will be added soon too!

notes.title: Dev Log January 2024 - Love n Life: Happy Student
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/71e8b125844df2bbe1f7b9c326883779fe175e1d.jpg

Our Journey to Deliver the Best Demo for You

Initially, our team set out with the goal of releasing a demo for you to enjoy this New Year.
Everyone on the team has been working tirelessly, but we recognize there are still some UX elements that need fine-tuning. While we currently have a playable demo, we’ve learned from past experiences that releasing anything less than polished would fall short of the respect we owe our valued players. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f1a893f45f6570c82acd600ecd77d1d882b2298a.jpg

We’re pouring our hearts and minds into this passionate project because we want the best for our beloved community, who has always supported us with love and care. You deserve nothing less than our eternal gratitude and unwavering dedication. 

That being said, we’ve shared the demo with our VIP community for early feedback. We’re on track to have it polished and ready for everyone by the end of February. Stay tuned. You won’t want to miss it!

Recent Milestones

We’d like to update you on the progress of the development. Our team is committed to raising the bar with even higher-quality gameplay and a meticulously crafted UI to ensure everything looks and feels just right.

Enhanced Socializing Matches: This is the addictive core gameplay of Happy Student. We’re adding additional visual features to better showcase the girls’ skills. Every time the ladies activate their special abilities, they’re sure to captivate you. Ready to stay focused and keep your head in the game?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/8f17ac25e378675dd4407b271f994380731d234f.jpg


We understand that items are the soul of an Inventory Management game. Our artists and game designers are working tirelessly to deliver not only quantity but also depth. Each lady and other characters have special builds designed to match them, but you’re always free to experiment with your own setups. This will promise many hours of fun and excitement, with countless possibilities for mix-and-match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/3dd42a3cebf554f1b589324a1dd90ec380a558dd.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/5a651f90e546d7ccf32094cc2102ec20a78f0045.jpg


Talking about the ladies, we are taking a step further to introduce more depth to their personalities. Each encounter will bring you unforgettable experiences. Don’t for a moment think this is just another light-hearted romantic story. There is a strong passion for love, to be sure, but get ready for unexpected twists and turns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/d6934c1df0c7b3426b57986828aa12200fd35bf4.jpg


But of course, it’s not always about dating and talking. You need rest, and we understand that. There are plenty of fun activities for you to enjoy, such as playing games, sports, fishing, art sessions, and more—helping you build stronger stats and, most importantly, stronger connections with the girls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/204bc9e7cbe1d3415e9dd4f1f12689100505deda.jpg


Since you’re living on an island, there are secrets to discover. Aside from the main ladies, you will also meet other interesting personalities that, let’s just say, will bring you extraordinary moments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4aec0951d88a4dc31f4b517f66bc0696a388882a.jpg


When we launched the teaser trailer, we were thrilled to see a surge of wishlists from all of you. Your support has been a massive motivator, and we’re more determined than ever to push this project to new heights.
[previewyoutube=K-HLx1llg9E;full][/previewyoutube]

Exciting improvements and surprises are coming your way. Thank you for believing in us!
💡 Don’t forget to support the project by wishlisting and following us on Love n Life: Happy Student. Every bit of support fuels our passion and brings us closer to delivering an unforgettable experience for you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/20762faf0fde784feeaaccade7d148d655dd02ed.jpg
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3149980/Love_n_Life_Happy_Student/



And don’t forget to keep supporting our previous games—they contribute directly to the rich content we’re creating for the future!

notes.title: Dev Log December 2024 - Love n Life: Happy Student
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4e10f997609a3de689023d7849de6decc5db06bd.gif
Every choice you make shapes their lives. Are you ready to meet the characters who will change yours?

When we design a character, especially one who will be your companion for a long journey, we pour our hearts and souls into every detail. From countless sketches to endless hours of refinement, we work closely with our VIP community to uncover the perfect faces that bring these characters to life. When it comes to their physiques and color palettes, our aim is clear: the moment you see them, their posture and the spark in their eyes should tell you everything about their style and personality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/e3073717cd26942f48fd4c8167e8e6dcbda770aa.jpg


When it comes to environments, we combine advanced tools with architectural expertise and thoughtful design to craft spaces that feel both logical and deeply immersive. Our goal is to draw you into a world where every detail makes sense and enhances your experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/f2e3af58bb163189f95e0092ab53ba89626fb5ef.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/c126ba8c2b3b86bcd4977886c2ee2869c9ab6361.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/1bac5150bd9c1c0188bd00d238365fd468d2f6cb.png

Liu Yating
After the rain comes the sunshine, and Yating embodies the perfect example of life's unstoppable energy. Carefree, vibrant, and overflowing with positivity, her optimism helps her rise above any negativity life throws her way.

Her design reflects this youthful dynamism, with bright colors that highlight her gentle femininity and irresistible charm. Imagine having a beautiful, lively classmate who also happens to share your dorm. What could be more heartwarming and relatable?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/49255f5768fa4c2c24a9f35d19a82900a031b2d0.jpg


Chen Meiling
"A man’s true potential lies in what he can achieve tomorrow." 
As a literature professor, Meiling holds the key to mastering the balance of life. She’s a caring and compassionate guide, always looking out for those she values. As both your dorm supervisor and a nurturing mentor, Meiling ensures every lesson is heartfelt. Whether it’s her guidance or the unexpected moments you’ll share in the dorm.

Her design blends a classic elegance with a youthful vibrancy. Does that sound like a contradiction? Discover more in Love n Life: Happy Student.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/31a2930d83c97f7a3efbdf11f8a07e0c10173256.jpg


Qin Yilin
When it comes to challenges, Yilin is the embodiment of discipline and determination. In academics, she has to be at the top. In every activity, she commands the game. The armband she wears isn’t just for show. It’s a symbol of the drive forged by her childhood and past experiences, which will undoubtedly surprise you. Stay tuned to learn more about Yilin’s story.

Yilin’s design exudes power and pride, balanced with elegance, discipline, and strength. You’ll be the one to uncover the events that shaped her into the formidable person she is today.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/4e7f33b1fafd9a1e7609f8ee35cb5b713556f826.jpg


Luna-3X
Your ultimate virtual assistant and so much more. She’s not just here to help you adapt and excel in your studies. She’s your go-to confidante, a cheerful companion, and even a quirky maid-slash-digital-girlfriend! Funny, kind, and completely drama-free (yes, no jealousy here), Luna-3X will even teach you how to win the ladies’ hearts. Her carefree nature puts her a step above Yating when it comes to lighthearted fun. Luna-3X guarantees laugh-out-loud moments and takes your relaxation to the next level. Just make sure you don’t accidentally turn her off!

Her cyberpunk-inspired design blends futuristic aesthetics with sleek modern vibes, delivering an experience that feels truly ahead of its time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248196/fa4962cf48ffd1212b449cb637c75d777c8e4986.jpg


And even more ladies are waiting for you:
Because you deserve even more, we’re excited to share a glimpse of some of the side characters you’ll meet in the game. Here are their sketches. Curious about their stories? Dive into Love n Life: Happy Student to find out more later!

notes.title: Fulfilling the Mission: Make Games the Community Truly Needs!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/23dd5fae9c8a87118a3b5fdc3a5e506b829807fb.jpg

It’s been 7 days since the release of Love n Life: Lucky Teacher - Light of a New Day and we’ve received so much support from all of you. Not only have many people purchased both the DLC and the base game, but we've also received valuable feedback, bug reports, and a lot of interest in our team. Although our resources are limited, the key members of our development team have been going through all the suggestions and feedback from you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2445340/Love_n_Life_Lucky_Teacher/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216840/Love_n_Life_Lucky_Teacher__Light_of_a_New_Day/

There have been many positive contributions along the way, and we've seen a significant improvement from the early versions to the current one, receiving a lot of praise from the community. Of course, we've also received some constructive feedback, particularly from people who gave up after not making it past the first 30 minutes of the game. This feedback made us realize some shortcomings in the early game design. However, Please know that the game becomes truly engaging once features, characters, locations, items, and more are unlocked.

We’re committed to ensuring that this design limitation won’t occur in our future projects. Please continue to support us, and if you encounter bugs, we would greatly appreciate it if you could send us the save files, logs, or screenshots with the version number. This will make it much easier for our dev team to investigate and fix the issues.

Today’s Hotfix 3.2.2:
Fixed an issue where the DLC interfered with the nurse girl, causing her to disappear from the supermarket if the DLC was not installed.

What’s next?
There will be an update with new outfits for the three girls: Rina, the secretary, and the farmer girl.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44176691/ca9c7908d9642468d46f41e580f5350d2cf0a3d0.jpg

With a heart seething with revenge and a mind honed by political intrigue, Solaire is a character with depths you can only begin to fathom.

Her thirst for vengeance knows no bounds, and she'll stop at nothing to see the nations involved in Helveti's fall brought to their knees. Her methods are dark, her motives unfathomable, and her actions are calculated with ruthless precision.

🪄 Dark Magic:

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/9ddb8101ad5fbe56609eed72a43b96805329b07b.jpg

Solaire's obscure personality keeps you on your toes. Her intelligence and political acumen are unmatched, making her an adversary you'll need to outwit, not overpower. In a game filled with intrigue, power struggles, and complex characters, Solaire shines as a dark star in her quest for revenge.

💔 A Saga of Betrayal:

notes.title: Agedor: A Young Nation with Ancient Roots
notes.content:
In Love n War universe, Agedor is a young nation, but it's filled with diversity and mysteries. Agedor emerged from those seeking freedom, leaving their homeland in the Drogakan Plains and daring to cross the Bone Mountain to settle in this rugged and forested land. They didn't just settle; they also integrated and bonded with the local forest tribes, creating a unique and culturally rich identity for Agedor.

Influences from Drogokad and Unique Geography:

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/09dafcf8487175448b66fc3bacf045bc137693b1.jpg
Agedor lies along a mountain range with its face towards the sea. With its territory filled with rivers, forests, and hills, it's well-suited for guerrilla warfare. Agedor also has plains and plateaus where villages and cities have been established. The capital of Agedor, Ystrad, is located in a flat grassland area near the confluence of three major rivers and numerous smaller streams.

Political Structure and Power Dynamics: 

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/964be769340502157acefa237e2494bb01125ea3.jpg
Despite some influence from Drogokad and unique geographical features, politics in Agedor is less convoluted compared to its predecessor, mainly due to its smaller population, which is less than 1/20th of Drogokad's. The power is concentrated in the hands of five major noble families: Moireach, Allanach, Vaughan, Duibshithe, and Caedici. These noble houses control vast territories, possess significant military strength, and play crucial roles in the political landscape. Most of the prominent generals and officials in the Agedor court come from these noble families.

The Massacre of the Five Great Houses: 

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/a20276af68f289f7af527f5d615e10d8a24f69b7.jpg
(Spoiler Alert)
[spoiler]The massacre of the five major noble houses 15 years ago was a seismic event in Agedor's history. This mysterious incident led to the deaths of the prominent families, except for Caecili and Moireach, where the last two survivors of each house escaped. Suspicion surrounded Solaire's involvement, though no one could confirm her role definitively. Julian Courtenay, her husband, fearing not only for his life but also that Solaire's involvement in the massacre might be exposed.[/spoiler]

The Hero: 

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/03541d1b2e5945b013cd10d1508a1f7c09ae0566.jpg
[spoiler]At the beginning of Hero by Chance, you were just a squire accompanying a group of diplomats as they attended an invitation from the Drogakan Emperor. However, circumstances unfolded that forced you into the role of a commander. After demonstrating your capabilities, William, the King of Agedor, entrusted you with the leadership of a small army. You not only achieved military victories but also diplomatic successes, securing a crucial alliance in preparation to confront the formidable aggression of the Drogakan Empire.[/spoiler]

Now, you begin from a distinct position. Despite holding the prestigious title of Lord Marshall, you have not been granted noble titles or land. Instead, you must rely solely on assets provided by the royal court and remain entirely dependent on the king's support. Nevertheless, your role is pivotal in saving Agedor from imminent doom. With your expertise in military strategy and the aid of our talented and alluring heroines, you emerge as a symbol of sacrifice and leadership amidst the encroaching darkness.

While the odds may be daunting, the potential rewards are equally significant. Wealth, relationships, and social standing can flourish if you manage to overcome these obstacles.

A Changeable Future: With Agedor facing crisis and turmoil, you have the opportunity to alter the nation's destiny. Political and military struggles, dependence and independence—all will combine to weave a dramatic tale. Be prepared to embark on this adventure and shape a new history for Agedor!

notes.title: Drogokad an Empire Forged by Legends
notes.content:
Welcome, fellow gamers, to a breathtaking journey into the heart of our game world. Today, we embark on a thrilling adventure to explore the rich history and complexities of the legendary empire known as Drogakan.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/53e5bc7f85da6bbc62a7aee482fdda3fa1ad7f51.jpg

The Birth of an Empire: 
Drogakan's story begins over 600 years ago, with the remarkable rise of Magnificent Scandar. At just 16 years old, he took up arms and embarked on a path that would forever change the course of history. By the age of 20, he achieved his first triumph and began expanding his influence.

Conquest and Unification:
Starting from the vast plains, Scandar's conquest extended westward, subjugating the ancient factions of Angharad, Gunhild, and many more. He quelled internal strife within the central regions of the continent and gradually pushed eastward. Scandar's ultimate dream was to unify the entire continent, stretching from the western coast to the eastern shores, encompassing Ishan and Agedor. To solidify his rule over the newly acquired lands, Scandar formed unions with the noble families of each conquered faction, aiming to unite all under one banner.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/68a15747741538c2368f231e8e1f1878194a82c1.jpg

Challenges Beyond the Bone Mountain:
At the age of 60, Scandar's campaigns took him to the formidable Bone Mountain range. Beyond this treacherous terrain lay the ancestral lands of Agedor, Caledov, and Ishan. This region was known for its unforgiving geography, with mountains and seas forming natural barriers that hindered military advances. The descendants of defeated factions and those seeking refuge found themselves in these lands, gradually establishing their own kingdoms. As of the events in Hero by Chance, only three of these kingdoms remain: Agedor, Caladov, and Ishan, forming a delicate balance of power.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/5309c0b99c593ac46a584f3a961e5689c6d33a4b.jpg

Scandar's Legacy and the Red Decade: 
Tragically, Scandar succumbed to illness at the age of 65, leaving behind over a hundred sons and numerous daughters. Although his intent was to unite all factions as one family, the reality turned out differently. Scandar's offspring began vying for the throne, leading to a blood-soaked struggle for power. Each child had the backing of a mother and a faction, laying the foundation for a turbulent era known as the "Red Decade." The very soil of Drogakan's imperial capital was irrigated with the blood of Scandar's own kin.
The Rise of Blessed Igraine: In the year 52 AMC (After Magnificent Scandar), Scandar's daughter, Igraine, with the support of her mother, a high priestess of the Jehdaism faith, established the Sisterhood of Filia Victoria. Igraine assumed the role of governing the empire, using politics and religion to bring the warring factions under her sway. In 82 AMC, she successfully united most of the facitons and appointed one of her younger brothers as the second official emperor since Scandar. Igraine's achievement led to her being revered as Blessed Igraine or Igraine the Just. The second emperor, in gratitude, recognized Jehdaism as the official state religion and elevated the Sisterhood of Filia Victoria to the empire's guardians. As the Sisterhood primarily comprised virgin girls, it evolved into a covert paramilitary force, undertaking various roles from safeguarding the imperial family to espionage, assassination, and intelligence gathering.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/1f010e73e6373365e9da79c23b04479bb96cb403.jpg

A Nation's Fate in the Shadows:
Those who joined Filia Victoria underwent rigorous screening, considering lineage and aptitude. The most exceptional among the young sisters were chosen for covert missions aimed at preserving Scandar's bloodline and preventing a repetition of the Red Decade. These "Daughters of Igraine" served as both protectors and, if necessary, bearers of the emperor's heirs, safeguarding the future of the empire. This secretive practice also served as a form of insurance against future political turmoil.


The Contemporary Political Landscape:
Drogakan, with its diverse ethnicities, beliefs, and religions, experienced political fragmentation, leading to numerous factions and parties. Three major political blocs emerged: the Dove Faction, led by the revered Reverend Mothers of Filia Victoria, advocating peace and conservatism; the Eagle Faction (In this, the house of Angharad is one of the two major houses), representing the descendants of Scandar's earliest warriors, envisioning a new empire; and a Neutral Faction, consisting of diverse elements.
The journey in Hero by Chance marks a turning point in the Drogakan history, as the current emperor stands on the precipice of a political struggle. Will he prove himself worthy of his lineage? Or will the empire descend into chaos once more?

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38811424/b5dc31d467b44be0cb13cb306a2dfd717d68041d.jpg

Join the Adventure:
Prepare yourselves to delve deeper into the intriguing world of Drogakan as you embark on your own quest within our game. The convergence of politics, ambition, and legacy has crafted a unique and captivating narrative that awaits your exploration.
Thank you for accompanying us on this epic journey, and may you become a part of the dramatic tale that is Drogakan!
